purpose: Convert the release from a strong single-run artifact into a controlled data-efficiency study.

experiments.hypothesis: The strict Stage 4 cleaning gate improves average downstream quality compared with a relaxed-filter continuation at the same token budget.
required_gates: same train steps, sequence length, and optimizer schedule
six-task eval completed for both checkpoints
stop_criteria: loss diverges by >0.15 from strict gate at matched token count
contamination gate reports retained benchmark overlap
wall clock exceeds 3 hours without completing 80% of planned tokens

experiments.hypothesis: A moderate math/code/tutorial share improves ARC-Challenge without materially damaging LAMBADA and PIQA.
required_gates: same cleaning gate across all variants
same token budget across all variants
stop_criteria: any variant exceeds source epoch cap
two consecutive evals show mean below base by >0.01
prepared tokens differ by >1% between variants

experiments.hypothesis: A sequence-length curriculum preserves short-task quality while enabling long-context continuation more efficiently than direct 8K training.
required_gates: report tokens/sec and estimated MFU by phase
six-task eval and long-context PPL eval completed
stop_criteria: direct 8K throughput below 40% of 2K baseline for two eval windows
short-task mean regresses by >0.01 without long-context PPL gain

experiments.hypothesis: Small, high-quality SFT with interpolation improves instruction behavior without erasing base-model competence.
experiments.success_metric: instruction sanity pass rate with six-task regression guard
required_gates: held-out instruction sanity set improves by >=2 points
no benchmark examples in SFT data
stop_criteria: full SFT repeats prior regression pattern
held-out instruction improvement is below 1 point after 2 variants
SFT data duplicate rate exceeds planned cap

experiments.hypothesis: GSM8K RLVR requires a larger base model than 135M to produce stable exact-match gains.
experiments.success_metric: GSM8K exact-match delta and prediction-rate stability
required_gates: same decoding settings before and after RLVR
report generation length and invalid-output rate
stop_criteria: exact match regresses for two consecutive checkpoints
reward hacking diagnostics show shorter-but-worse generations
